text:
Amelia Hart: hey team! first day here — Amelia (she/her). joining infra ops. quick setup issue: MDM enrollment failing on my new macbook, it gets to 'Installing profile' and then 'profile install failed'. any quick checks i should run? also hi!! excited to be here :tada: fun fact: i'm a backyard beekeeper 🐝 and bake sourdough on weekends.

Lila Chen: welcome Amelia!! for MDM errors usually system time + SIP can cause trouble. did you try restarting and opening System Settings > Profiles? also any screenshots?

Amelia Hart: thanks Lila — restarting didn't help. attaching the small error snippet i saw:```MDM profile install failed (1003)
com.apple.mdm: device not eligible for enrollment```

Marco Ortiz: hey — pinging @onboarding-bot to check asset + serial mapping. also, what's the device asset tag? format is REDW-xxxxx.

Amelia Hart: asset tag is REDW-09342. i don't see it in the laptop tracker page. link in my DM to people ops.

Devex Bot: Hi Amelia! I can help with common first-day commands. If you need the CLI: `curl -sL https://get.redwood.dev | bash` then `redwood login`. If MDM persists, run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and paste output.

Amelia Hart: ran `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` — output: `No such profile found` and then `MDM response: 403 - not authorized`

Samir Rao: welcome!! cc @People Ops — looks like the laptop wasn't registered to your account in our asset system, so MDM denies enrollment. People Ops, can you confirm the onboarding ticket?

People Ops: Thanks Samir — we flagged the asset mismatch and updated the tracker. Amelia, try re-enrolling now after a reboot. Also we'll drop a physical sticker pack and a welcome note in your desk: please choose between the sticker themes in this thread (space, pizza, debug cats). :gift:

Amelia Hart: rebooted and re-enrolled successfully!!! profile installed. you all are magic. also space stickers please 🚀

Benji: welcome Amelia — if you want, i can walk you through the first-day checklist quickly (15 min). will DM. also love the sourdough/bees combo. :bee: :bread:

Lila Chen: quick heads up — if you plan to run local model experiments, ask infra for GPU quota early. they'll need an RFC for non-prod GPUs.

Amelia Hart: noted, thanks Lila. super grateful for the quick help. excited to meet folks in person next week!

onboarding-bot: Ticket #ONB-4621 updated: Asset REDW-09342 assigned to Amelia Hart. Welcome pack scheduled for delivery 3/26.

Marco Ortiz: tiny follow — if you see any weird latency in Slack app, toggle 'Use system proxy' in Preferences, saved my life once.

Amelia Hart: adding to my mental checklist. thanks everyone :heart:
